tool_args.rationale: All five rows are already at the target horizon of 0.6, but s_grad spans only 0.018 and varies alongside u_now. The open-branch probe is the lowest-cost relevant way to separate sink inhibition from drive saturation before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a two-layer siphon with a square-root or linear branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot varies the drive but holds the sink gradient near 1, leaving the base amplitude and sink inhibition nearly confounded.
It can capture pilot concavity but cannot predict the sink-gradient response indicated by the pilot signature.
It costs more and targets temporal dynamics rather than the unresolved sink-gradient response at the requested horizon.
